records.source: any of ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` and ``"decode"``, run in that order. A phase left out reads what it needs from the database, so a well can be stitched once and decoded again. The alpha phenotype path (item 752) adds ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"merge"`` and ``"aggregate"``, asked for by name and run after those four; a run of only these needs ``dst_root`` and ``plate`` but no ``genotype_source``, takes its wells from ``ops_phenotype``, and adds to each well's ``ops_report.json`` rather than replacing it. ``aggregate`` pools the wells run and writes ``ops_guides_<plate>`` and ``ops_genes_<plate>``.
records.translation: hvaða af ``"stitch"``, ``"phenotype"``, ``"objects"`` og ``"decode"`` sem er, keyrt í þeirri röð. Fasi sem er sleppt les það sem hann þarf úr gagnagrunninum, svo hægt er að skeyta brunn saman einu sinni og afkóða hann aftur. Alfa-svipgerðarleiðin (atriði 752) bætir við ``"ph_segment"``, ``"ph_measure"``, ``"merge"`` og ``"aggregate"``, sem beðið er um með nafni og keyrð eru á eftir þessum fjórum; keyrsla með aðeins þessum þarf ``dst_root`` og ``plate`` en ekkert ``genotype_source``, tekur brunna sína úr ``ops_phenotype`` og bætir við ``ops_report.json`` hvers brunns í stað þess að skipta henni út. ``aggregate`` safnar saman keyrðu brunnunum og skrifar ``ops_guides_<plate>`` og ``ops_genes_<plate>``.

records.context: ``"percentile"`` takes spots above ``percentile`` in a channel; ``"median"`` takes spots where the channel is the argmax. Percentile is the more robust of the two when one base is rare, which is the case a median call gets wrong. ``"argmax_median"`` is brieflow's ``transform_medians``: each channel is first divided by its median over the spots, each channel's axis is the MEDIAN of the spots where it is the argmax, and the axes are scaled to sum to one rather than to unit length, which keeps the corrected channels on the scale the argmax compares. On 116 microscope fields of view of the Funk et al. 2022 laboratory microplates, after the per-cycle normalisation, it raised the library-exact read rate from 0.558 to 0.574 and lowered the decoy match rate.

records.source: ``"percentile"`` takes spots above ``percentile`` in a channel; ``"median"`` takes spots where the channel is the argmax. Percentile is the more robust of the two when one base is rare, which is the case a median call gets wrong. ``"argmax_median"`` is brieflow's ``transform_medians``: each channel is first divided by its median over the spots, each channel's axis is the MEDIAN of the spots where it is the argmax, and the axes are scaled to sum to one rather than to unit length, which keeps the corrected channels on the scale the argmax compares. On 116 fields of the Funk et al. 2022 plates, after the per-cycle normalisation, it raised the library-exact read rate from 0.558 to 0.574 and lowered the decoy match rate.
records.translation: ``"percentile"`` tekur bletti yfir ``percentile`` í rás; ``"median"`` tekur bletti þar sem rásin er argmax. Hundraðshlutamarkið er það traustara af þessu tvennu þegar ein basi er sjaldgæfur, sem er einmitt tilvikið sem miðgildisákvörðun fær rangt. ``"argmax_median"`` er ``transform_medians`` úr brieflow: hver rás er fyrst deilt með miðgildi sínu yfir blettina, ás hverrar rásar er MIÐGILDI blettanna þar sem hún er argmax, og ásarnir eru kvarðaðir þannig að summa þeirra sé einn í stað einingarlengdar, sem heldur leiðréttu rásunum á þeim kvarða sem argmax ber saman. Á 116 sviðum af plötum Funk et al. 2022, eftir stöðlun hvers hrings, hækkaði það hlutfall lestra sem passa nákvæmlega við safnið úr 0,558 í 0,574 og lækkaði hlutfall tálbeitusamsvarana.
